run_mypy_linter: run mypy type checking on Python files using the mypy_linter CLI with a config file
check_mypy_installed: check if mypy is installed and return an error LintMessage if it is not
check_files: check a list of Python files with mypy or dmypy and return lint messages
run_command: run a subprocess command with timing and logging support
parse_mypy_results: parse mypy stdout and stderr output using regex patterns to extract lint messages
